Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 29 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Kavita - 26 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Karan - 31 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Anjali - 31 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The temple - stone pillars, a big bell

Scene 1: The temple - Day

[Vinod stands in the temple. Kavita and Karan stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod rings the temple bell.]

Kavita: "Well done!"

[Vinod folds his hands and prays.]

Karan (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vinod kneels before the idol.]

Vinod: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
